text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"That's the day roughly everyone gives out 
chocolate. And one month later—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
All right, Kuu-chan! What kind of sweet 
treat would you like as a return gift from 
Dad?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~! Oh, stop it, you're flattering 
me!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, maybe I wanna grab that muffin over 
there and that chocolate sundae from TV 
the other day before heading home too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, aren't you quite the 
opportunist... ...Just for this year, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(The chocolates I give on Valentine's Day 
will return to the future me as double the 
reward...!)

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Mirako! Are you gonna give any to your 
Trainer? Chocolate, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. Girls who get a Trainer usually 
hand something over as a thank-you gift, 
right? So Mira-ko was thinking, maybe I 
should too... or something.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, gotcha, gotcha. So that's why it went 
to your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Dad's a grown-up, after all! I'll pay back 
triple—no, five times what I got right 
back to Cu-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this! Here's some 
chocolates from me to my grown-up Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"First is Dad's quota, of course. Make 
sure to grab his usual~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
While you're at it, grab Trainer's portion 
too—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if chocolates like Dad's are 
fine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer's just a little weird, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Looking around, my Trainer's definitely 
on the more fiery, passionate side.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(There are times when they believe in me 
so much it feels like they're expecting 
too much.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Enough to enter me, your trainee, into 
the Kikuka Sho, even.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(And she's such a softie that she'd 
probably thank me even for some cheap 
random chocolate.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Whichever one I eat, once it's in my 
stomach, chocolate is still chocolate, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Well, they've taken good care of me, 
after all.)

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Only 1 remaining of our Valentine's 
Special Edition Chocolates! Crafted by a 
renowned chef to resemble a red rose—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Roses! Ooh~... Wow~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha, that'd totally suit you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Alright. Excuse me, one of those—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: ? May I help you, customer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: N-No, no. It's nothing at all~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(T-Too expensive! That's five times more 
than Dad's chocolate!?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(No way! No, no, no! There's no way I can 
afford that on this month's allowance!)

text_block_list.name: Madame
text_block_list.text:
My! Could I have those chocolates? And may 
I request a message card as well?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Hello there, Trainer. Happy Valentine's 
Day~
choice_data_list: Aren't you looking a bit down...?
Don't you look a bit down...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~. No, no, not at all. Don't mention 
it~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I brought some humble chocolates 
that fit my modest stature. Please, go 
ahead, take some...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Not at all~... You're very welcome~.
choice_data_list:
I know, why don't I treat you to some 
okonomiyaki in return?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, yay~~! I really struck gold with that 
one~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Yay, yay! As expected, the return gifts 
for chocolate from adults come back more 
than doubled—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Why on earth was I feeling so down?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Even though your only goal in giving 
chocolate was to get something in return.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wah... Um.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: It's probably nothing at aaaaall~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ……Mmmgh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, hello? Mom? Um, you see—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Please give me an advance on my allowance!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Wah, oh no! I said it! Just for 
chocolate! All for the sake of chocolate!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Jeez, keep this a secret from Mom and the 
others, okay? They'll definitely say, 
"That's way too expensive!" I can already 
hear it without even asking—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...However...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I want to try reaching just a little bit 
higher.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Happy Valentine's Day~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufun. Be my guest, go right ahead.

When I opened the box Hishi Miracle handed 
me, an elegant aroma of cocoa gently 
drifted out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufun. ...Do you understand?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Weeell, it's quite the fine dish. Go 
right ahead and dig in!"
choice_data_list:
Thanks, I'd better think of something to 
give you in return.

Thank you, I'll have to think of a good 
return gift.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...! Ah, yes. A return gift? Oooh... well, 
that's...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Uhm.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...This time, I just gave it because I 
really wanted to.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You've always done so much for me, 
Trainer. This is my way of saying thanks."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please enjoy this as a token of my 
gratitude. There's no need for any return 
gift, so just take a bite.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Well then.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Pffft. Ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I totally put on airs, huh. Ahhh, man……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...Maybe I pushed myself too hard.)
